description: List the ISO images that can be mounted on the VPS (ZAP library and own custom ISOs) and the mounted one. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: list_vserver_isos
title: List VPS ISO Images
